notes: Multi Studio version 3.2.0: **AI Audio Enhancer**: Introduced a studio-grade speech enhancer powered locally by DeepFilterNet3. Clean up recordings, cancel ambient air conditioner rumble, street traffic, and fan hum, and strip out hollow room reverb with zero cloud dependencies or audio data leaving your computer., **Clean Space-Saving Tooltips for Enhancement Settings**: Replaced bulky static hint labels in the Settings panel with sleek, responsive tooltips across preset buttons, queue processing modes, and audio finishing options. This preserves vertical screen space and gives the configuration sidebar a modern, clutter-free design while keeping full explanations easily accessible on hover., **Integrated Top-Bar Progress Bar (Zero Table Bouncing)**: Consolidated overall batch progress tracking directly into the top bar with an inline spinner, progress bar, and percentage tag, as well as an edge-anchored progress line. Removed the separate progress banner above the table, completely eliminating layout shifting and vertical table bouncing during processing., **Studio Finishing & De-Hiss Suite (Gemini AI Speech Clean)**: Added specialized DSP audio filters engineered specifically for speech generated by Gemini 2.5 Flash / Pro and other AI voice models. Automatically strips away high-frequency frying sizzle, vocoder static, and digital artifacts that often accumulate over long speech generations., **Studio Silence Gate (Zero Hiss During Speech Pauses)**: Added an intelligent downward noise gate (-48 dB attenuation) that mutes background static to pitch-black silence during pauses and gaps between sentences, delivering clean, noise-free studio voice tracks., **Sub-Bass & DC Rumble Cut (75 Hz)**: Added a 75 Hz high-pass filter that purges sub-bass drone, electrical hum, and microphone pops without touching the natural warmth of human speech., **Gemini AI Voice Profile Preset**: Added a dedicated 1-click preset that instantly configures optimal vocal dereverberation, vocoder de-hiss, and silence gating in a single click., **Resume Batch Enhancement & Status-Smart Actions**: When a batch is interrupted, paused, or partially completed, the primary action button intelligently transforms into **"Resume Enhance (X remaining)"**, letting you pick up right where you left off without re-processing already completed tracks. Individual cards also display intuitive **"Resume"**, **"Retry"**, or **"Re-clean"** action buttons based on each item's processing status., **Smart Storage Cache Cleanup & Disk Space Protection**: Protects your computer from running out of disk space over time. Removing an item from the queue or clearing the list now immediately purges its cached preview audio from disk. In addition, an orphaned cache sweeper automatically cleans up abandoned preview files on app startup, and a dedicated **Storage & Local Cache** card in Settings lets you view cache usage and purge previews anytime., **Clear Queue Confirmation Dialog**: Replaced the confusing "Clear Cleaned" dropdown with a single, clean "Clear All" button protected by a safety confirmation dialog. This ensures accidental clicks never wipe your queue or delete your cached previews unintentionally., **Dynamic Scope Permission for Cross-Platform Previews**: Replaced static file patterns with dynamic runtime permission granting. Audio files located on any Windows drive (`C:`, `D:`, `E:`), external USBs, or Mac directories are granted streaming access dynamically on-demand, ensuring A/B previews never encounter permission or path errors regardless of operating system., **Direct Inline Sorting (No Popovers or Confusing Filters)**: Replaced popover menus and confusing options like "Cleaned First" with a sleek, 1-click inline segmented control (`[ Original | Name | Size ]`) right on the queue sub-header. Effortlessly cycle between File Name (`A-Z`, `Z-A`), File Size (`Largest`, `Smallest`), and Original Order with dynamic direction arrows and status tags, keeping queue sorting cleanly separated from status filter tabs., **Dual-Audio Instant A/B Track Switching**: Upgraded the card preview player to a dual-engine audio architecture. Toggling between "Cleaned" speech and "Raw Original" audio now happens instantaneously with zero latency and zero playback glitches or media errors, preserving your exact playback timestamp as you switch back and forth., **Queue Processing Mode (Sequential vs Turbo Concurrent)**: Added a configurable queue mode selector in the Settings panel. Choose **Sequential (1-by-1)** for lower CPU temperatures and gentle system resource usage, or enable **Concurrent (Turbo)** to process two audio files simultaneously, doubling your batch throughput on multi-core computers., **Batch Audio Processing & Target Item Enhancement**: Drag and drop multiple audio files or entire folders to process batches at once. Clean specific target files individually with a single click, re-clean completed items, or enhance all files in sequence with live progress tracking., **Full App-Restart State & Panel Persistence**: Automatically remembers your batch audio files queue, completed output tracks, custom enhancement settings, and split-panel divider dimensions across app restarts so your workspace is instantly restored when relaunching the desktop app., **Persistent Resizable Split Panels**: Modeled after the Studio Script and SRT Extractor layouts, the workspace features a flexible divider allowing you to resize the Settings panel and Batch Queue table to your liking. Your panel sizes are automatically remembered across app restarts without layout conflicts., **Unified Actions & Clutter-Free Controls**: Streamlined primary controls into a single, cohesive action bar. Enhancing and clearing actions automatically adapt to your selection—switching seamlessly between "Enhance All" and "Enhance Selected" without confusing duplicate buttons., **Centered Search & Inline Selection Status**: Moved the file search bar to the center of the queue header, while selection counts and quick actions now sit smoothly on the same line, eliminating disruptive jumping banners., **Safe Working Cache & Export On-Demand**: Cleaned audio is now safely held in the application cache instead of automatically writing files into your source directories. Your original folders remain clean and untouched until you explicitly export your recordings using the Export menu., **Full-Width Output Format Selector**: Removed the restrictive half-width layout from the Output Format dropdown, giving format options full natural width and eliminating cramped text., **Natural Text Selection on Queue Cards**: Enabled standard cursor text selection across batch queue items so you can freely select and copy track names, paths, and details., **Studio Export Menu**: Export your enhanced recordings anytime using the new Export menu. Save cleaned audio directly into a folder of your choice or package them into a single organized ZIP archive., **Inline Card A/B Audio Player**: Cleaned audio files now feature an embedded A/B audio player directly on each item card. Play, pause, scrub through the timeline, and toggle seamlessly between "Cleaned" and "Raw Original" without opening a modal dialog., **Adjustable Suppression & Studio Presets**: Fine-tune enhancement strength with one-click presets for Subtle cleaning (40%), Balanced cleanup (70%), Studio Podcast (85%), or Maximum suppression (100%)., **Automated Hardware & Tool Setup**: Runs smoothly across all Windows and Mac hardware (CPUs and GPUs). Automatically checks for required tools like FFmpeg and the AI model, offering one-click automated downloads if missing., **Universal Cursor Text Selection**: Removed all text selection restrictions (`select-none`) across setting labels, rows, and queue cards, ensuring users can freely select, highlight, and copy text, indices, and names throughout the application., **Sorted Queue Enhancement Order**: Resolved an issue where sorting the queue by Name or File Size and clicking Enhance still processed files in their original import order. The batch processor now respects the active sorted order, guaranteeing that File 01 on your screen is always the first file enhanced., **True Concurrent Batch Processing in Turbo Mode**: Resolved an issue where selecting Concurrent Queue Processing Mode still processed files sequentially. Dispatched CPU-bound neural enhancement tasks to dedicated background worker threads so 2 files actively process in parallel side-by-side with synchronized, smooth progress bars and zero thread blocking., **Speech Generator MP3 Audio Clarity**: Upgraded default internal MP3 audio encoding from 64 kbps to 128 kbps, eliminating compression haze and metallic swirling artifacts on newly generated Gemini speech tracks., **Seamless A/B Audio Toggle & Playback Error**: Resolved an issue where toggling between Cleaned and Original audio threw an error or interrupted playback when swapping sources. Audio now streams smoothly across all directories with zero interruptions., **Continuous Multi-Run & Batch Enhancement**: Resolved an issue where enhancing a single track and then running a batch or selecting remaining tracks stopped immediately. Retained a shared neural runtime environment across calls so individual enhancements and subsequent batches process reliably one after another without stopping.
